::: {.resources-intro}

Tools, training and learning material for the **Australian stock assessment community**.

Explore resources developed by the Community of Practice alongside useful tools, courses and communities from Australia and around the world.

:::

Brings together biological, catch and effort information to determine the status of Australia's key wild-catch fish stocks.

:::

:::: {.resource-row}

::: {.resource-name}
### Stock Assessment Learning Tool (SALT)
:::

A collection of interactive applications for learning about **stock assessment inputs and outputs**.

::: {.resource-action}
[Explore →](https://github.com/shcaba/Stock-Assessment-Learning-Tool){target="_blank"}
:::

::::


:::: {.resource-row}

::: {.resource-name}
### Natural Mortality Estimator
:::

::: {.resource-description}
Estimate natural mortality (**M**) using a range of life-history-based methods.
:::

::: {.resource-action}
[Open →](http://barefootecologist.com.au/shiny_m.html){target="_blank"}
:::

:::: {.resource-row}

::: {.resource-name}
### SSAND
:::

::: {.resource-description}
An R package for streamlining and providing consistency in stock assessment model outputs. Currently supports **Stock Synthesis and DDUST**.
:::

::: {.resource-action}
[GitHub →](https://github.com/QLD-Fisheries/SSAND){target="_blank"}
:::

::::


:::: {.resource-row}
